blocking: Changing the OS preference to reduced motion leaves the existing Lenis instance and ticker running.
Inner pages run perpetual branch animation without a pause control.
Opening the mobile menu during the hero morph displays the header logo without suppressing the travelling logo.

fixes.where: assets/js/site.js — reduced-motion listener and Lenis initialization
fixes.what: Store the Lenis ticker callback; remove it and destroy Lenis when reduced motion becomes active. Clear the instance and manage reinitialization explicitly.
fixes.why: The current preference-change handler stops GSAP decoration but leaves animated scrolling active.

fixes.what: Include the existing motion toggle on every page that runs buildMotion(), and preserve the visitor's pause preference across page navigation.
fixes.why: Continuous branch sway currently has no user-operated stop on these pages.

fixes.what: Hide the morph layer while the mobile drawer is open, show only the docked header logo, and restore the morph at the current scroll progress when closing.
fixes.why: The fixed morph sits above the header and remains visible when nav-open reveals a second logo.

fixes.what: For stacked mobile cards, remove the inactive overlay triggers from display and keyboard order and remove their disclosure attributes; restore triggers and synchronize aria-expanded with panel state on desktop.
fixes.why: Mobile exposes every body while announcing three as collapsed; activating those buttons produces no corresponding disclosure.

fixes.what: Reveal interactive containers immediately on focusin, including their hidden ancestors, without waiting for the scroll-triggered tween.
fixes.why: Opacity-hidden links, accordion buttons and form controls remain keyboard-focusable before their reveal finishes.

fixes.what: Defer cloud image requests until motion is enabled, and skip loading the hidden right branch on phones; request those assets when their relevant mode becomes active.
fixes.why: Reduced-motion and Save-Data visitors currently download unused decorative layers despite video loading being suppressed.
